about_the_game:
Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

Welcome to Ski Jumping World Cup - where every jump matters.

** Features**

- Global Arenas

Jump on meticulously designed hills inspired by real-world ski jumping venues.

- Deep, Skill-Based Gameplay

Master the takeoff, flight, and landing phases with physics that reward timing and consistency.

- Multiple Modes

Enjoy quick matches, classic 4-hill tournaments, full World Cup seasons, or practice at your own pace.

- Online Multiplayer

Challenge players worldwide in ranked competitions and climb the global leaderboards.

- Hot-Seat Fun

Play with friends on a single device and prove who’s the true champion.

- Day & Night Competitions

Take on your favorite hills in both daylight and spectacular night events under floodlights.

- Immersive Atmosphere

Dynamic weather, realistic wind conditions, and detailed visuals recreate the intensity and beauty of ski jumping.

short_description: Take flight in Ski Jumping World Cup - a true ski jumping adventure that takes you to legendary hills across the globe. From snowy peaks in Scandinavia to wind-swept arenas in Japan and record-breaking runs in the USA, every leap demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.
